title: extract_text: extract text from one column using regex
description: Use a regular expression to extract a match or capture group from one text column into a new column. Unmatched rows receive no_match, which defaults to null.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: The source text column. Must exist in the dataset.

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.description: Python regex pattern. The selected group must exist in this pattern.

parameters.name: new_column
parameters.description: Name for the extracted text column.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Regex group number to write. Use 0 for the full match or 1+ for capture groups. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: no_match
parameters.description: Value to write when the regex does not match. Defaults to null.

rag_note: Use extract_text only for extraction into one new column. Do not use it for replacement, splitting into multiple columns, or arbitrary Python expressions.
